crossRefs.note: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers,
Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,
and he took away all his livestock, and all his possessions which he had gathered, including the livestock which he had…
Now you are commanded to do this: Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and…
The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision…
They told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry…
Pharaoh called to Moses, and said, “Go, serve Yahweh. Only let your flocks and your herds stay behind. Let your little…
Our livestock also shall go with us. Not a hoof shall be left behind, for of it we must take to serve Yahweh our God…

people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
translations.bsb: Then Jacob departed from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel took their father Jacob in the wagons Pharaoh had sent to carry him, along with their children and wives.
translations.kjv: And Jacob rose up from Beersheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry
translations.asv: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
